title: ConPort And Dope Memory Read Adapters
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Add project-scoped ConPort and dope-memory read adapters with strict route allowlists, denylist tests, redaction, pagination, and canonical response envelopes.
why_this_packet_exists_now: After filesystem/git proof tools are locked, add the first service-backed evidence reads: structured decisions/progress and chronicle records.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Implement ConPort read adapter for GET /api/decisions, GET /api/progress, GET /api/search/{workspace_id}.
Implement dope-memory read adapter for /tools/memory_search and /tools/memory_replay_session.
Add tools search_decisions, search_progress, search_chronicle, replay_chronicle_session.
Add backend route manifest and tests.
Add mocked backend tests and optional live tests behind explicit env flag.
out: No dope-memory correction, reflection generation, issue mutation, storage, or link routes.

invariants: Registry binds project to ConPort workspace_id and dope-memory profile.
Caller cannot select workspace_id, base_url, port, or route.
All service calls time out and fail closed.
POST is allowed only for explicitly classified dope-memory read tool routes.
Output carries authority labels and redaction metadata.
plan: Add adapter route registry definitions for ConPort and dope-memory.
Implement read-only HTTP client wrapper with method/route checks.
Normalize all outputs to response envelope.
Add tests for denied mutating routes.
Add tests for workspace_id mismatch and caller-supplied backend rejection.
Add redaction tests for service payloads.
Document live-test env flags without enabling them by default.
Run tests, compile, grep for forbidden routes/methods, inspect diff.
validation_gates: ConPort GET decisions/progress/search allowed only through registry-bound service profile.
dope-memory search/replay accepted only through explicit read exceptions.
No bridge URL appears in adapter code except denylist tests/docs.
proof_requirements: AUDIT.md challenging POST read exception and route allowlist.
acceptance_criteria: Route-denial test suite proves no mutating route is callable.
rollback_steps: Revert adapter files and tests created by this packet.
stop_conditions: Backend read behavior cannot be bounded.
A route requires bridge access to work.
Denied route appears in implementation outside tests/docs.

auditor_focus: Could a caller hit ConPort mutation routes?
